episode_title: 今日雙語精華：政治風暴、言論自由與友誼的重量！
episode_summary: 本集雙語精華，我們將探討澤倫斯基對川普與普丁「奇怪友誼」的批評，及其對國際局勢的影響。接著，轉戰西班牙大選的激烈戰況。最後，關注土耳其對異議電視台的打壓，探討言論自由的困境。準備好迎接充滿觀點與 Reddit 爆笑留言的聽覺盛宴了嗎？

selected_links.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
Turkish officials 'destroyed' pro-opposition TV channel, owner tells BBC

segments.zh: 歡迎收聽今天的每日五分鐘雙語新聞與 Reddit 熱門精華。
segments.en: Welcome to today's five-minute bilingual news and Reddit highlights.

segments.zh: 今天是二零二六年十一月二十八號，我是你們的主持人小歐。
segments.en: It's November twenty-eighth, two thousand twenty-six, and I'm your host, Xiao Ou.

segments.zh: 今天我們要聊聊三件超有趣的事，從國際政治到言論自由，保證讓你聽得津津有味！
segments.en: Today, we're diving into three super interesting topics, from global politics to free speech, you won't want to miss it!

segments.zh: 首先，我們來看看烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基，他最近在英國廣播公司專訪中，對川普和普丁的「奇怪友誼」表達了不滿。
segments.en: First up, Ukrainian President Zelensky recently voiced frustration over the "strange friendship" between Trump and Putin in a BBC interview.

segments.zh: 他覺得美國沒有足夠施壓俄羅斯，讓烏俄戰爭早點落幕，這讓他很頭痛。
segments.en: He feels the U.S. isn't pushing Russia enough to end the Ukraine-Russia war sooner, causing him a major headache.

segments.zh: 澤倫斯基說，這種關係真的很「奇怪」，畢竟這兩位領導人立場完全不同，卻能維持友誼。
segments.en: Zelensky described this bond as truly "strange," given their vastly different stances, yet they maintain a friendship.

segments.zh: Reddit 網友們對此簡直炸鍋了！有人說：「這不叫友誼，這叫商業夥伴！」
segments.en: Reddit users absolutely blew up over this! One person commented, "That's not friendship; that's a business partnership!"

segments.zh: 也有人酸說：「奇怪？我覺得這友誼才不奇怪，根本是『利益共同體』吧！」
segments.en: Another sarcastically remarked, "Strange? I think this isn't strange; it's clearly a 'community of interests,' right?"

segments.zh: 還有人開玩笑說，搞不好他們有共同的興趣，像是…都喜歡穿超大件的西裝？
segments.en: Someone even joked, maybe they share common interests, like... both loving oversized suits?

segments.zh: 不過，也有比較嚴肅的討論，認為這反映出國際政治的複雜性，國家利益永遠擺在第一位。
segments.en: However, more serious discussions suggested this reflects complex international politics, where national interests always come first.

segments.zh: 澤倫斯基的發言，無疑讓這場國際大戲又增添了更多戲劇性。
segments.en: Zelensky's statement has undoubtedly added more drama to this international political saga.

segments.zh: 到底這段「友誼」會如何影響烏俄戰局，我們就繼續看下去。
segments.en: How this "friendship" will affect the Ukraine-Russia conflict, we'll just have to wait and see.

segments.zh: 接下來，把目光轉到歐洲，西班牙總理佩德羅·桑切斯正在努力打破民調預測。
segments.en: Next, let's shift our focus to Europe, where Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is trying to defy poll predictions.

segments.zh: 他和主要對手們在最後關頭，都卯足全力在全國各地為支持者造勢。
segments.en: He and his main rivals are going all out, rallying supporters across the country in a final push for votes.

segments.zh: 他的對手們可沒在客氣，直接指控桑切斯不老實，甚至還說他「背叛」了國家。
segments.en: His opponents aren't holding back, directly accusing Sánchez of dishonesty, and even calling his actions "betrayal."

segments.zh: 哇，這政治口水戰簡直比西班牙鬥牛還精彩啊！
segments.en: Wow, this political mudslinging is more exciting than a Spanish bullfight!

segments.zh: Reddit 上有網友說：「每次選舉都一樣，大家都在比誰的指控比較大聲！」
segments.en: On Reddit, a user commented, "Every election is the same; everyone just tries to out-shout each other with accusations!"

segments.zh: 另一位則表示：「政客們的承諾，就像海邊的沙堡，潮水一來就沒了。」
segments.en: Another remarked, "Politicians' promises are like sandcastles by the sea; they disappear with the tide."

segments.zh: 有人則幽默地問：「有沒有人跟我一樣，只想看他們會不會在辯論會上打起來？」
segments.en: Someone humorously asked, "Am I the only one who just wants to see if they'll actually fight during the debate?"

segments.zh: 這場選戰打得火熱，究竟誰能笑到最後，真的讓人很期待。
segments.en: This election battle is fiercely contested; who will have the last laugh is truly something to anticipate.

segments.zh: 選民們也睜大眼睛，看著這些政治人物的表演，準備投下他們關鍵的一票。
segments.en: Voters are also watching these politicians' performances closely, ready to cast their critical votes.

segments.zh: 最後，我們要來關注土耳其的言論自由狀況，這件事真的讓人很憂心。
segments.en: Finally, we need to focus on the state of free speech in Turkey, which is truly concerning.

segments.zh: 一家親反對派的電視台，Halk TV 的老闆告訴英國廣播公司，土耳其官員「摧毀」了他們的頻道。
segments.en: The owner of pro-opposition TV channel, Halk TV, told the BBC that Turkish officials "destroyed" their station.

segments.zh: 上個月，Halk TV 的總部遭到突襲，這是針對批評政府新聞來源的最新一波打壓。
segments.en: Last month, Halk TV's headquarters were raided, the latest in crackdowns on news sources critical of the government.

segments.zh: 這種直接打壓媒體的行為，真的讓人對新聞自由感到非常擔憂。
segments.en: This direct suppression of media truly raises significant concerns about press freedom.

segments.zh: Reddit 上有人義憤填膺地說：「這根本是現代版的焚書坑儒！」
segments.en: On Reddit, someone indignantly commented, "This is basically a modern-day book burning!"

segments.zh: 也有網友諷刺地說：「看來新聞報導的唯一標準，就是政府喜歡聽什麼。」
segments.en: Another user sarcastically remarked, "It seems the only standard for news reporting is whatever the government likes to hear."

segments.zh: 還有留言提到：「當政府害怕真相，他們就會攻擊傳播真相的人。」
segments.en: Another comment stated, "When governments fear the truth, they attack those who spread it."

segments.zh: 這提醒我們，新聞自由是民主社會的基石，絕對不能被輕易剝奪。
segments.en: This reminds us that press freedom is a cornerstone of democratic societies and must never be easily taken away.

segments.zh: 我們希望這種對媒體的打壓能早日停止，讓不同的聲音都能被聽見。
segments.en: We hope this suppression of media ends soon, allowing diverse voices to be heard.

segments.zh: 好的，今天的每日五分鐘雙語精華就到這裡告一段落。
segments.en: Alright, that brings us to the end of today's five-minute bilingual highlights.

segments.zh: 感謝收聽，別忘了訂閱我們的頻道，我們下週同一時間再見囉！
segments.en: Thanks for tuning in, don't forget to subscribe to our channel, and we'll see you next week at the same time!
